title: His brother with Robichaux; Sam Dutrey
summary: His brother played with Robichaux alongside Sam Dutrey and others; Justin had left Desvigne for Chicago.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: George Robichaux was with George for the last year now. He came up to me if you want to have some money.
Let's see who are we talking about? Some of the old Robichaux's bands.

No, my brother played with Robichaux. He played with him for a long time. Well you see at the time he was playing with Robichaux, oh I think I had left Desvene because I played with Desvene a year, not quite a year. And I came to Chicago and stayed in Chicago. But all during that time he was playing with Robichaux at the time. He and Sam Dutre and Dennis Gishard and Cyril August and.
Sam Dutre, that's the younger Sam Dutre I guess. His father was an old time.
Yeah, his father was an old time. Did you ever hear him? No, I've never heard his father.
